name: Wang Shifu
bio: Wang Shifu (Wang Dexin) was a playwright of Dadu, the Yuan capital (modern Beijing), active around the end of the thirteenth century. Little is known of his life; the Register of Ghosts (錄鬼簿, c. 1330) lists him among the earlier masters of zaju drama and credits him with fourteen plays, of which three survive.

His Story of the Western Wing (西廂記) recasts a Tang tale of the scholar Zhang and Cui Yingying as a drama in five books, far longer than the usual four-act zaju. Its sung arias, rhymed to set tunes, were admired as poetry in their own right, and the play became the most widely read and imitated love story of Chinese literature.
